correctness.rationale: The strictly positive circulant coin has eigenvalues 1, eta, p +/- ic and the tilted transfer matrix a simple analytic Perron branch at the origin. Exact 4x4 characteristic-polynomial identities for axial and diagonal displacement, with separate t^2 and t^4 expansions, give the displayed cumulant contrast and normalization. The common log-cumulant quadratic-square correction cancels. Algebraically dDelta/deta=3W/[2h(1-eta)^2]>0 on the precisely quantified open positivity domain, yielding the explicit inverse and the exact endpoint range. CHECKER.py verified both determinant identities and the inverse symbolically and compared 3000-step moment recurrences for six admissible coins, maximum absolute contrast error below 0.01. The general theorem is proved by spectral perturbation and algebra, not numerical extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The initiating 2026 paper supplies the model, reduced Fourier coin and second-order blindness, and the 2015 persistent-walk paper supplies a substantially broader forward fourth-moment framework and known higher-harmonic dependence; neither inspected text states the strict inverse mapping from one axial-minus-diagonal long-time cumulant, injectivity over the full positive coin, and sharp all-parameter realizability interval. Most similar published-finding corpus records classify fourth-cumulant signs/envelopes for continuous-time Poisson turning, not the discrete-time reduced-coin inverse. The nontrivial equivalence risk from general forward formulas is explicitly retained; negative searches alone do not establish novelty.
residual_risks: A published general fourth-moment formula could contain an implicit special-case inverse not called out in the inspected text; mathematical derivability is not independent priority certification.
Other inverse-persistent-walk work may have established equivalent monotonicity under different names.
The result concerns a reduced four-way coin; five-operation decompositions are nonidentifiable and are excluded from the uniqueness claim.

value.rationale: The three physically meaningful Fourier coin parameters cannot be recovered from full two-point velocity/MSD information because eta is exactly invisible. A single experimentally definable difference between two long-time projected fourth-cumulant slopes restores that missing mode with explicit strictly monotone inversion, a sharp all-positive feasibility range and unique reduced-coin reconstruction. These are structural, all-parameter identifiability/realizability results, not arbitrary finite recomputation or a generic textbook cumulant identity. No finite-sample noise performance is claimed.
